reviews.review_description:
So in Stranger Things-My bad I mean Save the Hawkins, you have to not only point at the level, and you have to press the trigger AND grab buttons at the same time. Already that’s such a weird way to design a start game feature of all things but anyway let’s move on… 

The gameplay genuinely looks and feels like it was designed in 5 minutes. 

The enemies look like they were stretched out horizontally and given a mega mushroom. Their walking animation is just pathetic, they look like they were speed up 8 times but yet they walk so slow. 

The gunplay is just bad. The rifle is on your left hand which isn’t that much of an issue, until you try to switch to the right hand, or let go of the weapon. Once you try to grab the gun with your other hand or let go of it, it does NOT align properly with the direction your controller is pointing at, AT ALL!

Oh and on top of that, the enemies literally take 20 bullets to die.

developer_response.body: Thanks for your review DevilBrandon , Things will be solved in upcoming updates
